name: binutils
test:
set +e
env -u SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH make CFLAGS='-O2 -g0' CXXFLAGS='-O2 -g0' -j1 -k check
make_exit=$?
set -e
python3 /opt/alp-infra/scripts/infra/test-policy.py binutils --build . --make-exit "$make_exit" --output binutils-test-policy.json
validation: Pinned MLFS ml-12.4 Binutils 2.45 native build. Reproducible flags and SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH apply to compile/install; tests run serially with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH and path-remapping flags omitted because the upstream suite checks native source paths and tests nondeterministic archives. Mandatory binutils/gas/ld summaries are evaluated by the strict pinned test policy; make failures are accepted only if the exact policy accepts completed raw summaries. DESTDIR install removes only book-listed static archives and gprofng documentation from the stage. No guest build or Alp ownership acceptance yet.
